description: Force an immediate plugin-update check (bypassing PUC's throttle) and report { available, current, remote, error } (plus throttled: true when answered from the cached check, about once per 30s). Read-only: it installs nothing. Apply an update from wp-admin or with mcp_update_plugin (cvrt-mcp-endpoints); the plugin deliberately has no self-update route.
name: fulfillment_update_check
